<thought>We have the molecular ion at m/z 224.12, suggesting a formula near C₁₂H₁₆O₄ (exact mass 224.1048 Da). The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 17 %) is consistent with ~12 C atoms. To confirm the structure we need NMR data, so the next cheap step is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(C)C(=O)OCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
